King Talal 3rd Mechanized Infantry Brigade (Arabic: لواء الملك طلال الآلي الثالث) is a mechanized infantry brigade of the Jordanian Armed Forces. It is one of the core combat formations of the Jordanian Northern Command, tasked with mechanized operations, combined arms maneuver, and rapid response in Jordan’s northern theater.
History
The King Talal 3rd Mechanized Infantry Brigade was formed on 1 December 1947. Since its establishment, the brigade and its subordinate units have participated in major engagements involving the Jordanian Armed Forces, including the 1948 Arab–Israeli War and the 1967 Six-Day War.
The brigade reports having sustained 277 personnel killed in action throughout its operational history.
The brigade’s units are currently deployed within the governorates of Jerash and Ajloun under the Jordanian Northern Command.
Current Organization
The brigade’s structure under the Northern Command includes combat, support, and service elements:
Brigade Headquarters
* Command Staff
** Joint Fires Coordination Cell - Targeting Cell
** Information and PsyOps Cell
** Intelligence Cell
* Signal Company
* UAS ISR Platoon
* FPV Strike Platoon
* JTAC Team
Brigade Combat Units
* Prince Hassan 4th Mechanized Infantry Battalion (YPR-765 pri)
* Imam Ali 8th Mechanized Infantry Battalion (M113A2 MK1)
*Prince Ghazi 18th Tank Battalion (M60A3)
* Anti-Armor Company (Kornet-E)
Fires Support (Direct Support, from Regional Command)
* 16th Field Artillery Battalion (M109A3)
*51st Field ADA Battalion (Shilka,Strela-10,Igla)
Combat Support (Direct Support, from Regional Command)
* 1st Engineer Company (DS, Command Engineer Battalion)
* Chemical Support Platoon (DS, Chemical Support Group)
Combat Service Support
* 1st Supply & Transport Company (DS, Command Supply & Transport Battalion)
* Brigade Maintenance Company (Vehicles & Weapons Workshop)
* Brigade Medical Company (Role 1)
Role
The brigade’s main roles are:
* Conduct mechanized and combined arms operations.
* Reinforce Jordan’s northern front defenses.
* Execute integrated operations with artillery, armored, and support units.
* Maintain readiness through regular training and exercises
Equipment
Equipment operated by the brigade includes:
* M60A3 Tanks
* YPR-765 Infantry fighting vehicles
* M113A2 Armored Personnel Carriers
* Kornet-E Anti-armor systems
* Tactical unmanned aerial systems
Training and Activities
The brigade conducts annual training programs in accordance with directives issued by the General Command of the Jordanian Armed Forces. In 2022, it carried out the collective exercise "Al-Najm Al-Thaqib" ("The Piercing Star") under the supervision of Northern Command leadership.
Training activities include live-fire exercises with light and medium weapons, defensive position drills, long-distance marches, combat readiness inspections, tactical loading drills, and physical fitness programs.
Prince Ghazi 18th Tank Battalion conducts regular armored readiness inspections and tactical maneuver training as part of the brigade’s operational preparedness.
